# netbox_module_type_profile (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/moduletypeprofile/):

> A module type profile defines a schema which specifies a set of attributes common to a group of module types. For example, all network interface cards might share a profile which captures information such as their port count or supported speeds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_module_type_profile" "test" {
  name        = "test"
  description = "This is my module type profile"
  comments    = "Some comments"
  schema = jsonencode({
    type = "object"
    properties = {
      port_count = {
        type = "integer"
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `schema` (String) A JSON-encoded object describing the schema of this module type profile.
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
